text:
tom: Holding release window — pipeline failing at artifact fetch with inconsistent checksums from object store. deploy-bot flagged integrity error and aborted promote.
anita: Paste the error?
tom: deploy-bot log:
```
[deploy-bot] GET https://artifacts.internal/releases/2026-03-21/app.tar.gz -> 200
[deploy-bot] downloaded blob size=12,345,678 bytes
[deploy-bot] sha256 mismatch (expected=5f3e..., actual=9b8c...)
[deploy-bot] cache-lease acquire: leaseid=lease-900 ttl=30s -> timed out
```
ops-bot: incident-detect: multipart-upload-incomplete detected for key releases/2026-03-21/app.tar.gz (age=2h)
lee: I saw a multipart upload fail earlier; some worker retried and completed parts but object metadata wasn't finalized. I can re-upload final manifest and recompute digest.
qa: If we force-promote we risk shipping corrupted artifact to canary. Recommend pin to currently-running digest (sha256:44aa66) and hold auto-promote.
anita: Agreed pin & hold. Tom, can you suspend auto-promote and flip routing temporarily to current digest?
tom: Doing: `/deploybot suspend R-2026-03-21-3` -> deployed. Routing pointed at sha256:44aa66 for next 45m. Will post comms.
lee: Reuploading final parts now with `aws s3api complete-multipart-upload` and then verifying with `sha256sum`. Will ping when verified.
ops-bot: cache invalidation queued for key releases/2026-03-21/app.tar.gz once reupload confirmed.
lee: Reupload done, sha256 matches expected (5f3e...). Pushed new object version and invalidated CDN edge keys.
qa: Running quick smoke and integration on reuploaded artifact.
deploy-bot: manual-promote request allowed by tom. Pre-promote smoke-run queued.
qa: Smoke ok, integration passed. No migration required.
tom: Manual promote approved. `/deploybot promote --manual R-2026-03-21-3` accepted. Rolling update policy: 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
anita: I'll draft release note: "Short pause due to artifact finalization failure; pinned to running digest until verified; manual promote after reupload and verification; rollout resumed."
lee: Filed follow-up: add CI preflight to check multipart-complete for artifacts and add alert on incomplete multipart uploads.
tom: Closing hold once rollout reaches 100%. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
